sqlMap.select:
SELECT H.EDU_SEQ, H.EMP_NO, M.EMP_NM, H.EDU_TYPE_CD, C.CD_NM AS EDU_TYPE_NM, H.EDU_NM, H.EDU_YEAR, H.EDU_HOURS, H.INST_NM FROM TB_EDU_HIST H JOIN TB_EMP M ON M.EMP_NO = H.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.GRP_CD = 'EDU' AND C.CD = H.EDU_TYPE_CD
H.EDU_TYPE_CD = #eduTypeCd# H.EDU_YEAR = #eduYear# H.EDU_NM LIKE '%' || #eduNm# || '%'
ORDER BY H.EDU_YEAR DESC, M.EMP_NM
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT H.EMP_NO) AS EMP_CNT, NVL(SUM(H.EDU_HOURS), 0) AS TOTAL_HOURS FROM TB_EDU_HIST H JOIN TB_EMP M ON M.EMP_NO = H.EMP_NO WHERE H.EDU_YEAR = #eduYear# AND H.USE_YN = 'Y'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EDU_HIST (EDU_SEQ, EMP_NO, EDU_TYPE_CD, EDU_NM, EDU_YEAR, EDU_HOURS, INST_NM, REG_DT, REG_ID) VALUES (SEQ_EDU_HIST.NEXTVAL, #empNo#, #eduTypeCd#, #eduNm#, #eduYear#, #eduHours#, #instNm#, SYSDATE, #regId#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE TB_EDU_HIST SET EDU_TYPE_CD = #eduTypeCd#, EDU_NM = #eduNm#, EDU_HOURS = #eduHours#, INST_NM = #instNm# WHERE EDU_SEQ = #eduSeq#
